core_obligations: Recall the colimit presentation of the henselization and the equality of ideals (proof lines 3095-3098).
Derive flatness from flatness of etale maps and stability under colimits (proof lines 3098-3100).
Upgrade the isomorphism modulo the ideal to all powers for each stage (proof lines 3101-3103).
Pass to the colimit to obtain the quotient isomorphisms (proof lines 3104-3106).
proof_roadmap: Quotients by powers via the colimit (proof lines 3101-3106).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects the flatness and the quotient behaviour of the henselization of a pair. The proof reads both statements off the construction of the henselization as a filtered colimit of etale algebras which induce isomorphisms modulo the ideal: flatness follows because etale maps are flat and flatness is preserved by filtered colimits, and the isomorphism statement follows by applying the same quotient-compatibility to each stage and passing to the colimit.
